Private-sector candidates need 11 years’ total experience with an annual CTC of at least Rs. 24.10 LPA as on the last date of application. Experience equivalence (Cluster-I, Manager posts only – not stated for Assistant Manager posts in the source): Govt./PSU/Autonomous Organization candidates need 5 years’ total experience with at least 2 years in the IDA pay scale of Rs. 40,000–1,40,000 or CDA Level 7 of the 7th CPC pay matrix (or equivalent). Private-sector candidates need 5 years’ total experience with an annual CTC of at least Rs. 16.27 LPA as on the last date of application. UR/EWS candidates (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts) need a First Class degree/minimum 60% marks; reserved-category candidates need at least 50% marks for consideration against reserved posts. The degree must be recognized by AICTE/UGC (as applicable), from a University/Institution established or incorporated as prescribed by law; Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination is also accepted as equivalent. If the certificate/marksheet does not show First Class/percentage, the applicant must submit the university’s CGPA-to-percentage conversion formula; absent a formula, an institutional undertaking is required, and 6/10 on a 10-point scale will be treated as 60%. Training (except on-the-job), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience does NOT count as experience; Apprenticeship Act, 1961 training in the relevant discipline does count, subject to other eligibility conditions. Date of acquiring qualification is the earliest of: last day of the month of the final qualifying exam, date of declaration of result, date of issuance of marksheet, or date of issuance of degree – no relaxation is given on this account.

content_sections.heading: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age relaxation (common to both clusters): RITES regular/contract employees meeting the qualification and experience criteria get 5 years’ relaxation over the upper age limit. Additional relaxation: SC/ST – 5 years; OBC-NCL – 3 years; J&K Domicile – 5 years; Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) – 10 years (in addition to SC/ST/OBC-NCL relaxation where applicable), subject to the post being identified suitable for PwBD and production of required certificates. PwBD relaxation applies irrespective of whether the post is reserved, provided it is identified suitable for PwBD as per the notified table (Civil discipline: Locomotor disability and Hearing Impairment categories are identified suitable, per the respective cluster’s table).

content_sections.heading: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale
content_sections.text: Pay will be fixed at the minimum of the scale. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates get DA, fixed/variable allowances, Performance Related Pay, medical facilities, HRA/lease accommodation, PF, Gratuity, Post-Retirement Medical Scheme, leave as per rules, Maternity/Paternity Leave, Group Insurance and Leave Encashment. Employees appointed on regular basis from other PSUs/Govt. organizations who applied through proper channel or submitted an NOC at interview are eligible for pay protection (Basic+DA) as per Company policy.

content_sections.heading: RITES Limited Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Written Test: 125 objective-type questions, 1 mark each, duration 2.5 hours. No negative marking. PwBD candidates get 50 minutes’ compensatory time. Qualifying marks: minimum 50% for UR/EWS, 45% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD against reserved posts. Document Scrutiny: Based on written-test results and vacancies, RITES scrutinizes submitted documents; shortlisted candidates are called for interview preceded by original document verification. Interview: Candidates are called in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies. Weightage: Written Test – 60%; Interview – 40% (Technical & Professional proficiency 30, Personality/Communication/Competency 10). Minimum interview marks: 60% for UR/EWS, 50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD against reserved posts. No minimum qualifying marks are required in the aggregate. Test centers (tentative, subject to number of candidates and RITES’ discretion, except Delhi/Gurgaon): Delhi/Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Mumbai, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati. Candidates give two center preferences; RITES reserves the right to allot any center. Document Scrutiny: Submitted documents are scrutinized; eligible candidates are called for original document verification and the selection process. Interview: Weightage – Interview 100% (Technical & Professional proficiency 65%, Personality/Communication/Competency 35%). Minimum interview marks: 60% for UR/EWS, 50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD against reserved posts. No minimum qualifying marks are required in the aggregate. Candidates may appear for the selection process in Hindi or English. Based on requirement and RITES’ discretion, the written test and/or interview may be conducted from Regional Offices, intimated via call letters. Appointment is subject to being found medically fit as per RITES Rules and Standards of Medical Fitness for the relevant post. Selected candidates will be on probation for 1 year and must clear a screening test for confirmation; failure may extend probation. Selected candidates are liable for posting anywhere in India or abroad as per Company requirements. An employee’s application will not be forwarded for outside jobs until 2 years of RITES service is completed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RITES Limited Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Ensure you satisfy the eligibility conditions for the VC No. you intend to apply for (Cluster-I or Cluster-II). Apply online in the registration format in the Career Section of rites.com ; note the ‘Registration No.’ generated for future reference. Carefully and correctly fill in all details under “Fill/Modify Application Form”. Upload all supporting documents under the “Upload Document” section, substantiating your eligibility claims (list in the Documents section below). Make the online payment under the “Make Payment” section; download the final application form after successful payment. Applications without successful fee payment are treated as incomplete and summarily rejected. Submit only one application per vacancy; the application cannot be altered once submitted. Important: Hard copies of documents are not to be sent by post/courier. Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous body organizations on a regular basis must apply through proper channel, or bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview (if called) to be eligible for pay protection and other benefits; NOC submitted after the interview date will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates and mark sheets of all academic/professional qualifications (10th, 12th, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation, as claimed) Percentage Conversion Document from the University/Institute (wherever applicable) EWS/SC/ST/OBC Certificate in the prescribed Govt. of India format (wherever applicable) Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Aadhaar Card, etc.) PAN Card Proof of each period of experience claimed, in a single PDF in chronological order (offer letter, joining order, relieving letter, service certificate, relevant pay slips, etc.) PwBD Certificate as per latest format (if applicable) Any other document supporting your candidature and claims Printed, signed copy of the online Application Form with Registration Number 1 recent passport-size colour photograph Self-attested photocopies of all documents listed above, strictly in order, plus originals for verification Duly filled two copies of Annexure-A (Documents Submission Checklist) with supporting documents in chronological order For CTC/salary proof: last Form No. 16/Earning Card/salary slip/Appraisal letter or similar document (also reproducible on the day of interview) Caste Certificate as per Annexure I (SC/ST) or Annexure II (OBC-NCL), valid as on the cut-off date, plus the OBC-NCL Annexure III non-creamy-layer declaration where applicable EWS Income & Asset Certificate (Govt. of India format, valid FY 2026-27), where applicable

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Management reserves the right to cancel/restrict/enlarge/modify/alter the selection process at any stage without notice; the number of vacancies may vary. Candidates from Government organizations/PSUs joining RITES must first be properly relieved from their parent organization. If a candidate is found not to fulfil eligibility norms, or has furnished incorrect/false information or suppressed material facts, their candidature is liable for cancellation – even after appointment, in which case services are liable to be terminated. Any corrigendum/addendum will be displayed only on www.rites.com; applicants should keep checking for updates. An offer letter is not proof of experience; joining/relieving order or experience certificate is required to claim experience. Legal jurisdiction for any dispute is Delhi. No fares/TA/DA is payable for the selection process. Where a specialization is required in the qualifying degree, a certificate from the University/Institution specifically confirming the specialization must be submitted. OBC-NCL and EWS certificates must not be older than one year on the cut-off date (last date of application); non-compliance means the candidate will be considered under General (UR) vacancies only, if otherwise eligible. Candidates found guilty of misconduct at any stage of recruitment (or later) are liable to legal/criminal prosecution and disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. How many total posts has RITES advertised across both clusters?
faq.answer: 33 posts in total – 4 DGM posts (Cluster-II) and 29 Manager/Assistant Manager posts (Cluster-I).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Both clusters share the same window – online applications and fee payment open on 15 September 2026 and close on 8 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is there a written test for all posts?
faq.answer: No. Only Cluster-I (Manager and Assistant Manager) posts have a written test, on 25 October 2026. Cluster-II (DGM) posts are selected through document scrutiny and interview only.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: 41 years for DGM, 35 years for Manager, and 32 years for Assistant Manager posts (as on the cut-off date, 8 October 2026), with additional relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, J&K Domicile, PwBD and RITES employees.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: For Cluster-I: Rs. 600/- plus taxes for General/OBC candidates, Rs. 300/- plus taxes for EWS/SC/ST/PWD candidates (refundable for SC/ST/PWD upon participation in the selection process, subject to category certificate scrutiny). For Cluster-II: Rs. 600/- plus taxes is the fee stated in the source document, with no separate reduced fee tier shown for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay scale for these posts?
Q7. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: DGM posts need a minimum of 11 years post-qualification experience (min. 8 years relevant); Manager posts need a minimum of 5 years (min. 3 years relevant); Assistant Manager posts need a minimum of 2 years (min. 1 year relevant, for most posts).

faq.question: Q8. Can private-sector candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, subject to meeting the minimum CTC threshold on the last date of application – Rs. 24.10 LPA for DGM posts and Rs. 16.27 LPA for Manager posts (not separately stated for Assistant Manager posts in the source document).
